pattern: Static meter: svg role="meter" (WAI-ARIA 1.2) named by the title, with aria-valuenow/min/max and an aria-valuetext that names the band and the target.

roles.element: arcs, target marker, reading, band name, range ends
roles.role: aria-hidden (the value text carries the meaning)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
The value clamped to min-max; removed when the value is null
Localized "{value} ({min} to {max}), {band}, target {target}", for example "72% (0% to 100%), Busy, target 60%"; "No value" (plus the target) when the value is null; or valueText

keyboard.action: Not focusable (a static reading); screen readers reach the meter in browse mode.

notes: Meaning never depends on color: the value is printed in the center, the current band's name is printed under it and included in the value text, and the target is named in the value text.
The value arc (color-chart-<slot>) meets 3:1 against surfaces; the track (color-chart-grid) only frames it.
Forced colors: the value arc uses Highlight, the track GrayText, bands, target, and text CanvasText.
knownCaveats: role="meter" is ARIA 1.2 and support varies across screen readers and browsers.
The description is visible text only; it is not referenced by aria-describedby.
